title: Field
description: One roster column and the Certify system field it maps to.

name.description: CSV column header this mapping applies to, exactly as it appears in the roster file.

mappedKey.description: Key of the Certify system field this column maps to, from the field catalog returned by `GET /templates/fields`. The sentinel `[skipped]` marks a column the user explicitly chose not to map: skipped columns persist in the template/mappings CSVs but are excluded from the generated validation schema.

mappedEntity.description: Entity that owns the mapped attribute (for example `practitioner` or `location`). When set, `mappedKey` is accepted as-is instead of being validated against the system-field catalog.

entityGroup.description: Group label linking columns that belong to the same repeating entity instance (a multiple-value group), so related columns are ingested together.

isRequired.description: Whether every roster row must supply a value for this column; drives the `required` constraint in the generated validation schema.

isStaticField.description: Catalog metadata: whether the mapped system field is a static (fixed-value) field rather than one populated from roster data.

isSingleSelect.description: Catalog metadata: whether the mapped system field accepts a single value from a fixed option list.

validationRegex.description: Regular expression applied to this column's values during roster validation. Rows whose values do not match are rejected.

description.description: Human-readable description of the mapped system field, from the field catalog.

hasPattern.description: Catalog metadata (CP-40222): true when the system field schema validates values with a regular expression. The expression itself is deliberately NOT exposed here — the mapping UI shows the plain-language `message.pattern` text instead, and `validationRegex` stays reserved for user-defined per-column rules so a catalog entry posted back as a mapping cannot tighten the generated schema.

format.description: JSON Schema `format` of the system field (`date`, `email`, `uri`, ...) when it has one. Catalog metadata for the mapping UI (CP-40222); the accepted formats are described in `message.format`.

message.description: Plain-language validation texts from the system field schema, keyed by the rule they describe (`pattern`, `format`, `enum`, `type`, `minLength`, `maxLength`). The mapping UI shows these instead of raw regexes (CP-40222). Absent when the schema defines none.

conditionallyRequired.description: When present, the field is required only under a tenant condition: `condition` names the tenant setting, `value` the value that triggers the requirement and `message` the explanation shown to users (CP-40222).

minLength.description: Minimum accepted length of the value, when the schema bounds it.

maxLength.description: Maximum accepted length of the value, when the schema bounds it.

enum.description: Allowed values for enum-type system fields; roster values outside this list fail validation. Absent for free-form fields.

separator.description: Literal separator character used to split a single cell value into multiple tokens for multi-value attributes. Blank or absent defaults to a comma at schema-generation time.

notes.description: Free-text note on this template column, such as a pre-processing instruction. Stored per template in the `Notes` column of the template's mappings CSV; not used by validation or ingestion. Blank or absent means no note.
